records.product_name: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine
records.source_qualifier_decision: Confirm the actual vending process, point-of-sale container, filtration and dispensed sampling matrix under FSSR 2.10.9 before considering packaged-drinking-water contaminant articles.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Confirm FSSR 2.10.9 and the actual dispensing/packaging condition, water quality criteria, legal contaminant standard and sampling.
records.forbidden_transfer: Dispensing purified water from a vending machine does not by itself establish that the marketed finished article is packaged drinking water.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Separate roasted chicory, coffee beans and blended coffee–chicory composition under FSSR 2.10.4; ingredient-specific copper articles do not establish a finished-mixture limit.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Verify actual coffee-to-chicory proportion, product standard 2.10.4, finished-form contaminant article and test basis.
records.forbidden_transfer: FSSAI distinguishes dried or roasted chicory and coffee beans in individual metal source articles; a compounded coffee-chicory mixture must not automatically receive a single-ingredient limit.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Resolve children’s age band, supplement legislation, formula and intended serving first; infant-formula contaminant articles cannot be automatically borrowed.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Verify target age, full ingredient formula, special regulation and finished form
records.forbidden_transfer: Formulated supplements for children are not the same article as infant formula

records.source_qualifier_decision: Identify each fruit species, presence of added ingredients, freezing state and raw-to-frozen processing or concentration factors before invoking any raw-fruit pesticide commodity.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Establish each actual fruit/vegetable commodity, processing treatment, composition, regulatory pesticide scope and an authorized processing factor before computing any finished-product residue conclusion.
records.forbidden_transfer: A raw-fruit MRL reference is not an automatic finished processed-food assessment for fried, frozen, cooked or mixed vegetables and pastes. For vegetable-only goods it is a negative comparison, not a candidate.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Verify dried coconut kernel with or without partial oil removal under FSSR 2.3.45; neither coconut oil nor a generic raw oilseed is the same finished article.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Identify finished desiccated kernel, species, drying process, carrier and exact processed-commodity article
records.forbidden_transfer: Desiccated coconut is not necessarily a raw oilseed or a coconut oil commodity

records.source_qualifier_decision: Confirm botanical material, catechu extraction and finished edible-grade article under FSSR 2.11.2; do not substitute synthetic dye or tannin impurity provisions.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Identify botanical source, extraction, food grade and specified catechu product article
records.forbidden_transfer: Edible catechu is not a generic dye or tannic-acid purity material

records.source_qualifier_decision: Identify pickled fruit species, acidity, brine, cooking and packaging under FSSR 2.3.43; pulp articles and untreated fruit pesticide MRLs are not automatic finished pickle limits.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Confirm exact finished product (fruit pulp, fruit bar, preserve, candied peel, raw/dried fruit or mixed confection), the source article's processing scope and product-specific analytical matrix.
records.forbidden_transfer: Fruit ingredient content, fruit drying, added sugar or fruit peel does not on its own prove finished pulp/pulp product or untreated raw-fruit pesticide commodity identity.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Fruit cheese made from concentrated cooked pulp under FSSR 2.3.33 needs positive legal evidence that the as-sold matrix qualifies as 'pulp and pulp products of any fruit', rather than only containing fruit pulp.
positive_proof_to_obtain: prove the as-sold cooked paste/cheese/toffee is legally a fruit-pulp product, not simply made using a fruit input
finished formulation and heat/solids/water content plus concentration factor
CTR legal article scope, method, sample preparation and other contaminants
records.forbidden_transfer: Fruit pulp ingredient does not automatically mean finished fruit sweet qualifies as fruit-pulp article.

records.source_qualifier_decision: FSSR 2.3.41 general mixed chutney is not FSSR 2.3.42 mango chutney; require a documented mango-only product identity before considering the named mango-chutney articles.
positive_proof_to_obtain: recipe and product name establish Mango Chutney rather than mixed chutney
confirm analytical finished-product basis and correct version
quality under FSSR 2.3.41 and packaging verified separately
records.forbidden_transfer: Fruits and Vegetable Chutney does not automatically mean Mango Chutney.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Murabba is preserved whole or cut fruit in syrup under FSSR 2.3.25; confirm syrup/fruit sample basis and reject direct inheritance of fresh-fruit or fruit-pulp metal standards.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Confirm exact finished product (fruit pulp, fruit bar, preserve, candied peel, raw/dried fruit or mixed confection), the source article's processing scope and product-specific analytical matrix.
records.forbidden_transfer: Fruit ingredient content, fruit drying, added sugar or fruit peel does not on its own prove finished pulp/pulp product or untreated raw-fruit pesticide commodity identity.

records.product_name: Candied, Crystallised And Glazed Fruit / Vegetable / Rhizome / Fruit Peel
records.source_qualifier_decision: Candied or glazed fruit and peel under FSSR 2.3.26 retain distinct peel/rhizome/fruit forms; fruit-pulp copper/arsenic/tin articles require a separately proven matching product.
positive_proof_to_obtain: prove the as-sold cooked paste/cheese/toffee is legally a fruit-pulp product, not simply made using a fruit input
finished formulation and heat/solids/water content plus concentration factor
CTR legal article scope, method, sample preparation and other contaminants
records.forbidden_transfer: Fruit pulp ingredient does not automatically mean finished fruit sweet qualifies as fruit-pulp article.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Fruit Bar or Toffee under FSSR 2.3.19 may use concentrated pulp but has its own dried sweet matrix; match legal 'pulp products' scope and measurement basis before any article assignment.
positive_proof_to_obtain: prove the as-sold cooked paste/cheese/toffee is legally a fruit-pulp product, not simply made using a fruit input
finished formulation and heat/solids/water content plus concentration factor
CTR legal article scope, method, sample preparation and other contaminants
records.forbidden_transfer: Fruit pulp ingredient does not automatically mean finished fruit sweet qualifies as fruit-pulp article.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Seedless tamarind under FSSR 2.3.49 needs botanical identity, processing and finished edible pulp versus whole fruit determination before processed-pulp or fresh-fruit limits apply.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Confirm exact finished product (fruit pulp, fruit bar, preserve, candied peel, raw/dried fruit or mixed confection), the source article's processing scope and product-specific analytical matrix.
records.forbidden_transfer: Fruit ingredient content, fruit drying, added sugar or fruit peel does not on its own prove finished pulp/pulp product or untreated raw-fruit pesticide commodity identity.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Date paste under FSSR 2.3.56 requires as-sold date paste formulation and process; ingredient dates alone do not establish a legal fruit-pulp-product article.
positive_proof_to_obtain: prove the as-sold cooked paste/cheese/toffee is legally a fruit-pulp product, not simply made using a fruit input
finished formulation and heat/solids/water content plus concentration factor
CTR legal article scope, method, sample preparation and other contaminants
records.forbidden_transfer: Dates made into paste are not automatically covered by the legal fruit-pulp grouping without article-scope confirmation.

records.product_name: Edible Dried Seeds obtained from Fruits
records.source_qualifier_decision: Fruit-derived edible dried seeds require exact botanical seed species and handling state; fresh fruit, edible oilseed and nut standards must not be conflated.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Identify exact fruit species, edible seed form and relevant seed commodity class
records.forbidden_transfer: Dried fruit seeds do not inherit fresh fruit MRLs or every oilseed mycotoxin limit

records.source_qualifier_decision: Frozen vegetables under FSSR 2.3.38 are not dehydrated non-onion vegetables; quantify process and identify vegetable commodity before applying fresh or dried-food metal/residue rules.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Document the precise finished vegetable or processed matrix, moisture/process, any named finished-article source and the analytical sample basis.
records.forbidden_transfer: The Version IX lead article explicitly covers dried or dehydrated vegetables (other than onions), not any frozen/cooked/curried or non-dehydrated finished vegetable product. Do not transfer fruit residue or dried vegetable limits into this processed food.

records.product_name: Thermally processed Curried Vegetables/Ready to Eat Vegetables
records.source_qualifier_decision: Cooked curried ready-to-eat vegetables under FSSR 2.3.4 require recipe, heat treatment, pack and water content; a dried-vegetable article is a comparison, not an assigned limit.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Document the precise finished vegetable or processed matrix, moisture/process, any named finished-article source and the analytical sample basis.
records.forbidden_transfer: The Version IX lead article explicitly covers dried or dehydrated vegetables (other than onions), not any frozen/cooked/curried or non-dehydrated finished vegetable product. Do not transfer fruit residue or dried vegetable limits into this processed food.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Fresh ginger paste under FSSR 2.3.28 is not dehydrated vegetables; confirm moisture, ingredients and finished paste article, including separate ginger-specific pesticide scope.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Document the precise finished vegetable or processed matrix, moisture/process, any named finished-article source and the analytical sample basis.
records.forbidden_transfer: The Version IX lead article explicitly covers dried or dehydrated vegetables (other than onions), not any frozen/cooked/curried or non-dehydrated finished vegetable product. Do not transfer fruit residue or dried vegetable limits into this processed food.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Frozen ready-to-eat curried vegetables under FSSR 2.3.39 require both cooked recipe and frozen-state confirmation; neither raw crop nor dried vegetable lead criteria can transfer by name.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Document the precise finished vegetable or processed matrix, moisture/process, any named finished-article source and the analytical sample basis.
records.forbidden_transfer: The Version IX lead article explicitly covers dried or dehydrated vegetables (other than onions), not any frozen/cooked/curried or non-dehydrated finished vegetable product. Do not transfer fruit residue or dried vegetable limits into this processed food.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Quick frozen fried potato under FSSR 2.3.60 is heat-treated and oil-containing; raw potato pesticide and dehydrated-vegetable articles are not direct finished-food matches.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Document the precise finished vegetable or processed matrix, moisture/process, any named finished-article source and the analytical sample basis.
records.forbidden_transfer: The Version IX lead article explicitly covers dried or dehydrated vegetables (other than onions), not any frozen/cooked/curried or non-dehydrated finished vegetable product. Do not transfer fruit residue or dried vegetable limits into this processed food.

records.product_name: Edible Dried Seeds obtained from Vegetables
records.source_qualifier_decision: Vegetable-derived edible dried seeds require species, seed maturity and intended food use; vegetable flesh, fruit seed and oilseed limits are distinct.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Identify vegetable species, harvested seed form and legally named seed article
records.forbidden_transfer: Dried vegetable seeds are not equivalent to vegetable flesh or arbitrary oilseed articles

records.source_qualifier_decision: Dried fruit, nut or vegetable mouth freshener can be a mixture without sugar boiling; finished recipe and thermal process must confirm any named hard-boiled confectionery article.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Verify boiling/deposition/cooling technology, principal sugar composition, official hard-boiled product identity, finished physical form and complete source table.
records.forbidden_transfer: General confections, starch sweets, nuts, fruit sweets, savouries and mouth fresheners are not identified as hard-boiled sugar confectionery solely by FoSCoS category.

records.product_name: Other traditional mouth fresheners not covered under 5.2.4.1 and 5.2.4.2
records.source_qualifier_decision: Unclassified traditional mouth freshener needs complete constituent and processing evidence; the FoSCoS category does not imply hard-boiled sugar confectionery.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Verify boiling/deposition/cooling technology, principal sugar composition, official hard-boiled product identity, finished physical form and complete source table.
records.forbidden_transfer: General confections, starch sweets, nuts, fruit sweets, savouries and mouth fresheners are not identified as hard-boiled sugar confectionery solely by FoSCoS category.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Carob powder under FSSR 2.11.7 comes from Ceratonia siliqua, not cocoa; cocoa-powder lead/copper limits and fat-free analytical bases do not transfer.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Verify Ceratonia siliqua plant source and FSSR 2.11.7 identity; do not inherit cocoa-powder lead/copper
records.forbidden_transfer: Carob powder is a distinct botanical material and is not cocoa powder or cocoa cake.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Animal casing needs source species, collagen or intestinal tissue, salt/curing and consumption basis; muscle meat veterinary-residue values cannot be mapped without tissue evidence.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Identify source animal species, intestine/collagen tissue, processing and residue/sample matrix
records.forbidden_transfer: Animal casings cannot inherit muscle-meat veterinary residue MRLs without tissue match

records.source_qualifier_decision: Icing sugar under FSSR 2.8.1(6) may contain permitted starch; establish actual ingredient and sulphated-ash result rather than equating starch/total ash with >1% sulphated-ash lead article.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Specific finished sugar/syrup identity and documented laboratory sulphated ash % together with other legal article conditions.
reference_articles_comparison_only: All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent
records.forbidden_transfer: Ash in FSSR product identity is often total/acid insoluble; do not silently equate it with measured sulphated ash >1%.

records.source_qualifier_decision: FSSR 2.8.7 caps sulphated ash of dried glucose syrup at 1%; the CTR lead article expressly requiring more than 1% cannot justify compliance for a standard-conforming product.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Specific finished sugar/syrup identity and documented laboratory sulphated ash % together with other legal article conditions.
reference_articles_comparison_only: All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent
records.forbidden_transfer: Dried Glucose Syrup FSSR 2.8.7 requires sulphated ash ≤1%; this conditional >1% Lead article cannot be a compliant exact source.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Cube sugar under FSSR 2.8.1(5) has its own total-ash quality limit; actual sulphated ash cannot be assumed from that total-ash value for the high-ash lead clause.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Specific finished sugar/syrup identity and documented laboratory sulphated ash % together with other legal article conditions.
reference_articles_comparison_only: All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent
records.forbidden_transfer: Ash in FSSR product identity is often total/acid insoluble; do not silently equate it with measured sulphated ash >1%.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Misri under FSSR 2.8.2 is a distinct crystallized sugar and permits various origins; its total-ash quality figure cannot be substituted for measured sulphated ash >1%.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Specific finished sugar/syrup identity and documented laboratory sulphated ash % together with other legal article conditions.
reference_articles_comparison_only: All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent
records.forbidden_transfer: Ash in FSSR product identity is often total/acid insoluble; do not silently equate it with measured sulphated ash >1%.

records.product_name: Polyols permitted under Appendix-A of FSS(FPS&FA) Regulations,2011 excluding those already standardized
records.source_qualifier_decision: A generic Appendix A polyols category represents several chemicals; first prove named INS/CAS identity and individual applicable purity/metal article, not 'sorbitol' by default.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Identify individual polyol INS identity, chemical grade, preparation and specific purity article
records.forbidden_transfer: Polyols collectively are not sorbitol alone

records.source_qualifier_decision: Composite salt substitutes under FSSR 2.9.30(6) may use potassium, magnesium and sodium salts; the finished blend is not necessarily food-grade sodium chloride.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Identify potassium, magnesium, sodium fractions and composite salt-substitute article
records.forbidden_transfer: Salt substitutes are not automatically pure food-grade salt

records.source_qualifier_decision: Seasoning under FSSR 2.9.31 may contain mixed wet or dry ingredients; ascertain actual dry herbs/spice identity and moisture before considering the dehydrated-onion/dry-spice metal article.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Verify the seasoning is legally covered by the dry herb/spice/seasoning named article, recipe and moisture test basis.
records.forbidden_transfer: Dehydrated onion/dried herbs/spice source article is not automatically the finished article of every seasoning or mixed sauce.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Culinary pastes under FSSR 2.3.28 require named vegetable/spice recipe and as-sold water content; the non-onion dehydrated vegetable lead article is not a paste article.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Document the precise finished vegetable or processed matrix, moisture/process, any named finished-article source and the analytical sample basis.
records.forbidden_transfer: The Version IX lead article explicitly covers dried or dehydrated vegetables (other than onions), not any frozen/cooked/curried or non-dehydrated finished vegetable product. Do not transfer fruit residue or dried vegetable limits into this processed food.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Vegetable protein products under FSSR 2.3.59 need plant source, extraction, concentration and named crop presence; an aflatoxin composite article is conditional on documented qualifying ingredients.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Identify the qualifying plant source and its named aflatoxin category, protein extraction processing, finished-food constituent scope, and relevant analytical basis.
records.forbidden_transfer: The named composite food aflatoxin row applies only after verifying qualifying source ingredient identity; it is not a blanket limit for all vegetable proteins.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Starch-based sweets may be gelled, fried or steamed, unlike hard-boiled sugar candy; prove manufacturing process and FSSR 2.7.1 finished candy identity before that lead article is considered.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Process record supporting hard-boiled confectionery manufacture and finished-food classification under FSSR 2.7.1, including recipe and batch records.
records.forbidden_transfer: Indian Confections and Starch based Sweets are broad FoSCoS identities; they do not establish that the final cooked product qualifies as Hard boiled sugar confectionery.

records.product_name: Dry Fruit and nuts based Sweets
records.source_qualifier_decision: Dry fruit and nut-based sweets are composite products; document whether sugar has actually been boiled to a hard-candy glass phase rather than inheriting hard-boiled confectionery by category.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Verify boiling/deposition/cooling technology, principal sugar composition, official hard-boiled product identity, finished physical form and complete source table.
records.forbidden_transfer: General confections, starch sweets, nuts, fruit sweets, savouries and mouth fresheners are not identified as hard-boiled sugar confectionery solely by FoSCoS category.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Indian confections under category 18.1 encompass many processes; a hard-boiled sugar sweet requires specific product formula, cooked-mass processing and FSSR finished-article evidence.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Process record supporting hard-boiled confectionery manufacture and finished-food classification under FSSR 2.7.1, including recipe and batch records.
records.forbidden_transfer: Indian Confections and Starch based Sweets are broad FoSCoS identities; they do not establish that the final cooked product qualifies as Hard boiled sugar confectionery.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Fruit and vegetable sweets can be syrup-soaked, cooked, gelled or dried; fruit pulp input does not establish hard-boiled confectionery identity for final limit selection.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Verify boiling/deposition/cooling technology, principal sugar composition, official hard-boiled product identity, finished physical form and complete source table.
records.forbidden_transfer: General confections, starch sweets, nuts, fruit sweets, savouries and mouth fresheners are not identified as hard-boiled sugar confectionery solely by FoSCoS category.

records.product_name: Fruit and vegetable based snacks & savouries
records.source_qualifier_decision: Fruit and vegetable savouries are not presumed to be hard-boiled candy; verify savoury composition, processing, moisture and relevant finished-article classification.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Verify boiling/deposition/cooling technology, principal sugar composition, official hard-boiled product identity, finished physical form and complete source table.
records.forbidden_transfer: General confections, starch sweets, nuts, fruit sweets, savouries and mouth fresheners are not identified as hard-boiled sugar confectionery solely by FoSCoS category.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Mixtures and premixes of food additives require individual INS identities, carriers and concentrations; individual additive metal or monograph tests are not blanket mixture standards.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Document every INS additive, carrier, dilution and formula percentages
records.forbidden_transfer: An additive premix is not automatically equivalent to a purified single additive

records.source_qualifier_decision: Colouring foods under FSSR 2.3.65 differ from refined food colours; extraction process, dry colouring matter and material identity determine which specific impurity article could apply.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Identify actual plant extract, chemical colouring material, extraction process and applicability of any dry colouring matter testing basis
records.forbidden_transfer: Colouring foods are not always regulated as a listed purified colour additive

records.source_qualifier_decision: Trehalose standard 3.3.4 does not establish high sulphated ash; verify chemical identity, purity and measured sulphated ash before considering any sugar-derived lead article.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Identify chemical trehalose form, standard 3.3.4, measured sulphated ash and actual named lead article
records.forbidden_transfer: Trehalose is not automatically a high-sulphated-ash sugar

records.source_qualifier_decision: Traditional Sajji Khar alkali contains source-dependent salt fractions; identify sodium/potassium species and production process rather than applying sodium-hydroxide purity limits.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Establish traditional alkali source, major constituents, preparation and separate purity standard
records.forbidden_transfer: Sajji Khar is not automatically purified sodium hydroxide or sodium carbonate

records.product_name: Additives permitted under Appendix-A of FSS (FPS&FA) Regulations, 2011 and other food safety standards regulations excluding those already standardized and additives of Nutraceutical Regulations
records.source_qualifier_decision: Broad Appendix A permitted-additive entries need a discrete substance identity, INS/CAS number, form and legal monograph; no unique finished article exists for the category alone.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Identify INS/CAS number, individual additive monograph, grade, concentration and use
records.forbidden_transfer: A general additive category is not one chemical purity article

records.product_name: Additives VA-VF of Nutraceutical Regulations excluding those already standardised
records.source_qualifier_decision: Nutraceutical Schedule VA–VF additives must be individually identified and distinguished from standardized food additives; schedule classification is not a metal-limit article.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Identify legal schedule entry, ingredient chemical form and finished use
records.forbidden_transfer: Nutraceutical Schedule VA-VF grouping is not a single product contaminant article

records.product_name: Permitted enzymes and their preparations excluding those already listed under Processing Aids and Nutraceutical Regulations
records.source_qualifier_decision: Enzyme and preparation entries require EC enzyme, microbial source, manufacturing purification, carrier and intended processing-aid status; chemical additive limits are not automatically applicable.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Identify enzyme EC number, microorganism origin, formulation, processing aid and purification route
records.forbidden_transfer: Enzyme preparations require enzyme and production-route purity review, not blanket additive rows

records.product_name: Ingredients listed under Schedule IV, Schedule VI and Schedule VIII of Nutraceutical Regulations
records.source_qualifier_decision: Ingredients grouped under nutraceutical Schedules IV/VI/VIII require the exact listed ingredient and grade before contaminant class and analytical basis can be established.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Identify the exact Schedule IV, VI or VIII entry and substance, grade and composition
records.forbidden_transfer: Nutraceutical ingredient-schedule group cannot receive a single universal metal/MRL article

records.source_qualifier_decision: Functional ingredient premixes require each active component, dose, carrier and legal standard; single-ingredient contaminant articles cannot certify an undifferentiated blend.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Identify entire ingredient recipe, concentrations, function, carrier and operative schedules
records.forbidden_transfer: Functional ingredient premix cannot inherit one ingredient's contaminant article for the mixture

records.source_qualifier_decision: Royal Jelly under FSSR 2.8.3(3) is a bee secretion with separate forms; honey, beeswax and ordinary sugar contaminant classes are not interchangeable.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Verify royal-jelly standard 2.8.3(3), bee-derived subtype and manufacturing form
records.forbidden_transfer: Royal jelly is not honey, beeswax or a generic sugar

records.source_qualifier_decision: Pan Masala under FSSR 2.11.5 requires the actual full ingredient and processing matrix; metal limits on areca/spices cannot automatically be declared finished-pan-masala limits.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Find exact FSSR finished-product identity and directly applicable Version IX article, purity test, analytical measurement basis and current amendments.
records.forbidden_transfer: The FSSR 2.11.5 Pan Masala food is not a generic sugar confectionery or spice input; ingredient metals are not automatically finished-food limits.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Edible silver leaf (Chandi-ka-warq) under FSSR 2.11.4 requires metallic purity and leaf identity evidence; a plated/silver-coated confectionery is a different finished matrix.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Find exact FSSR finished-product identity and directly applicable Version IX article, purity test, analytical measurement basis and current amendments.
records.forbidden_transfer: The FSSR 2.11.4 edible silver leaf is a metal-leaf finished article, not the same legal metal-contaminant matrix as silver-coated sweets.

records.source_qualifier_decision: Soluble dextrin dietary fibre under FSSR 2.11.8 needs starch origin, hydrolysis, fibre identity and ash; it is not automatically solid glucose or high-ash starch-conversion product.
positive_proof_to_obtain: Verify starch source, hydrolysis method, degree of polymerisation and actual sulphated ash
records.forbidden_transfer: Soluble dextrin fibre cannot automatically inherit high-ash starch conversion or sugar metal limits
